base: Amounts the executor or administrator actually receives or pays out in cash during administration, excluding cash on hand or in financial institution/brokerage accounts at death, life insurance proceeds and cash paid to heirs or legatees (Tex. Est. Code § 352.002).

schedules.text: 5% commission on all amounts actually received or paid out in cash in administering the estate (Tex. Est. Code § 352.002(a)); the court may allow reasonable compensation instead in the cases of § 352.003.
schedules.capNote: Total commission may not exceed 5% of the gross fair market value of the estate subject to administration (§ 352.002(b)(1)); excluded receipts/payments listed in § 352.002(b)(2).

testCases.source: computed by hand: 5% x 100,000 of eligible cash receipts and payments
